## Type of Change

- [ ] `feat` — New feature
- [ ] `fix` — Bug fix
- [ ] `docs` — Documentation only
- [ ] `refactor` — Code change (no new feature or bug fix)
- [ ] `chore` — Maintenance (deps, config, build)
- [ ] `test` — Adding or updating tests
- [ ] `style` — Formatting (no logic change)

## Checklist

- [ ] My branch is rebased on the latest `develop`
- [ ] `npm run lint` passes with no errors
- [ ] `npm run build` succeeds (no compilation errors)
- [ ] I tested my changes locally (both server and client)
- [ ] No `console.log` statements left in the code
- [ ] `.env.example` is updated if I added new environment variables
- [ ] No hardcoded values (using env vars or constants)
- [ ] I stayed within my feature folder (no unrelated changes to shared files)
